origin.title: It started with a plumber.
origin.p1: Sergio needed to book an appointment with his plumber. The plumber was working and couldn't pick up. He called back later — Sergio couldn't answer. They kept missing each other, call after call.
origin.p2: It raised an obvious question: after decades of digital transformation, why does getting help by phone still depend on two people being free at exactly the same moment?
origin.question: Dattivox is the answer to that question.
